record.body: Signature recorder arrays are designed networks of unattended Signature recorders spread across a fictional landscape, with a localisation rule: when the same designed call reaches several recorders at different times, the time differences reveal the caller's position. The array's spacing, schedule, and battery limits are design parameters, stated in advance, and the total recorder-hours are computed from them. No real landscape is monitored by this array; it is a design for a fictional monitoring program. Array recordings in the design contain all three Signature layers, and analysis separates Signature biophony from Signature geophony and Signature anthrophony.
